text:
Maya: heads up — customer pilot requires BYOK onboarding + extended retention asks (up to 7y) and exportable evidence. want to align launch criteria and a minimal playbook. anyone available to triage?
Sam: ack. two quick constraints: SOC2 evidence needs append-only chain + tamper-evident hashes. 7y is fine but we need archival storage plan.
Aj: for BYOK handshake we can do a staged flow: 1) manual key upload 2) automated keystore handshake 3) escrow option. staging will help rollout. latency impact minimal if we use async evidence export.
Dylan: customers also want an export format that's ingestion-friendly (newline-delimited JSON + provenance header). they asked for checksum + signature per exported bundle.
Elena: legal: long retention ok for customers but we need legal-hold override + export audit trail. define retention TTLs per tenant with override flag and audit records.
Maya: suggested launch checklist: a) BYOK upload + UI + API b) evidence export v1 c) retention TTL UI + legal-hold d) docs and runbook. anything missing?
Sam: add: KMS provider matrix (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure) + HSM/OKMS caveats. also rotation policy docs.
Aj: implementation note: evidence export job should write to s3-compatible target with metadata file. sample config:
```
export:
  format: ndjson
  target: s3://customer-exports/{tenant}/
  sign: true
  kms_key: arn:aws:kms:... # customer key or service escrow
```
Nikhil: prioritization: MVP must cover manual BYOK + export v1 + retention TTL. escrow & full automation can be v2. propose 3 sprint plan.
Dylan: support runbook: include troubleshooting for key handshake failures, manifest validation, replays. will prepare templates.
Maya: tradeoffs: shipping manual BYOK first gets customers onboarded quickly but increases ops load. automation reduces ops but delays GA. agree on staged rollouts and canaries?
Sam: agree. we should gate GA on pass of canary with two customers and SOC2 evidence tests (integrity + provenance). add regression monitor for exported bundle hashes.
Elena: contract language: need explicit customer responsibility for key custody + SLA language for export delivery windows. legal team will draft.
Aj: estimate: BYOK upload + UI + API = 2 sprints, export v1 job + manifest = 1 sprint, retention UI + legal-hold = 1 sprint. automation/escrow = separate 2-sprint workstream.
Maya: action items: @Aj create PRD with API surface; @Sam draft threat model + SOC2 test cases; @Dylan build support runbook stub; @Elena draft contract addendum; @Nikhil include prioritization in roadmap deck. I'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow.
Ops Bot: Reminder: Draft runbook template created at docs/runbooks/byok-onboarding.md (auto).
Nikhil: I can take the roadmap slide and slot the MVP for next quarter, will mark v2 as dependency.
Maya: thanks all. leaving notes here for the sync. :thumbsup:
